name: page-hero
description: Utility page hero for the 2026 company and resource pages (integrations, partners, compare, FAQ, tutorials, about, careers, reviews, ROI calculator): an eyebrow, a headline with an optional gradient phrase, lede paragraphs, check chips, two buttons and badges on the soft brand colour wash; centred, or split beside a framed product image. An optional stat row closes it. The eyebrow can carry the page h1 (live's small-label h1 pattern) with the headline as the h2.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

layout.description: center: copy centred on the wash. split: copy left, image right from 1001px (stacked below); needs image.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the headline.

eyebrow_tag.description: h1 when the page's h1 is the small label (live: 'Asset Panda Integrations' over 'Integrating With The World's Best'); then title_tag should be h2.

title_tag.description: Headline level: h1, or h2 when the eyebrow is the h1.

title_accent.description: Words inside the headline painted with the brand gradient (first occurrence); must appear in title.

lede.description: Copy under the headline. A blank line starts a new paragraph; single line breaks are kept; [label](url) makes a link and **double asterisks** bold.

chips.description: Short check-marked points under the copy (plain strings).

cta_label.description: Primary (gradient) button text. Renders only with cta_url.

cta_url.description: Primary button destination (a page, #anchor, http(s) or mailto:).

secondary_label.description: Secondary (outline) button text. Renders only with secondary_url.

badges.description: Badge images under the buttons. Each: image (URL), alt, optional w and h (intrinsic px; drawn 56px tall).

image.description: split: the hero image (PNG/WebP). Loaded eagerly with high priority (it is the page's largest paint).

image_width.description: Image intrinsic width in px (sets the aspect ratio; 0 omits it).

image_frame.description: card: the image sits in a white rounded frame with a soft shadow (screenshots). plain: drawn as is (cut-out art).

stats.description: Optional figures along the bottom. Each: value (e.g. 30+) and label.
